reviewer: Codex curation and independent automated cross-review
scope: Seventeen use-case definitions: the seven previously published cases plus ten question-led priorities with explicit planned collection and zero new mappings. All previous questions, seventeen mappings, fifty-seven evaluation references and 26,124 scientific records are preserved. Two authored workflow documentation sources are added. Separate automated clinical-definition, research-definition and code reviews found no material issues; review concerns definitions, not clinical sign-off.
limitations: Automated source curation and cross-review are not human domain review, clinical validation or independent experimental replication.
The ten new definitions contain proposed comparisons, conventional baselines and evidence needs; no model scores, rankings or applicability claims are introduced.
Workflow citations justify the user decision. They do not establish effectiveness of a named model or access rights to patient-level data.
Collection is planned. Qualified scientific reviewer roles and source-specific acquisition permissions remain unassigned or unverified where stated.
All existing mapping fingerprints and numerical results are unchanged; builds validate frozen review bytes and do not renew them automatically.
